There was '''an ocean''' which surrounded [[Reef Fortress Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]]. [[Carnivorous seaweed]] grew in the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] and it contained a jagged rock formation called the [[Dragon's Teeth]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />
